gold_answer: Санағыштарды пайдаланыңыз. `python class InterleaveRatio: def __init__(self, A, B, ra=2, rb=1): self.A, self.B = iter(A), iter(B) self.ra, self.rb = ra, rb self.ca, self.cb = 0, 0 def __iter__(self): return self def __next__(self): if self.ca<self.ra: try: self.ca+=1 return next(self.A) except StopIteration: pass if self.cb<self.rb: try: self.cb+=1 return next(self.B) except StopIteration: pass self.ca=self.cb=0 return self.__next__() print(list(InterleaveRatio('AAAA','bb',2,1))) `
